title: Resolve Java var declaration types for extract-method captures
wanted_capability: Given a Java file plus a var declaration or methodRegions capture/live-out fact, return the inferred concrete type suitable for helper parameter or return overrides.
missing_primitive: java.resolveVarTypes / type-at-declaration for Java var captures
fallback_used: Probe agent manually searched declaration sites, inferred simple new-expression types, and traced a method-call return type through another class before calling java.extractMethodCodeBlock with explicit parameters and returnType.
notes: Sanitized from a private Java calculation-stage probe. Existing fail-closed var-capture guard is useful, but this gap is the next ergonomic step: resolve or project explicit types so probes don't hand-roll declaration tracing.
